sentences.text: App for Respondent : Mr. V.S. Badakh.

Coram : Mangesh S. Patil, J.
Date : 27.02.2020
Per Court :

The applicant is seeking bail in anticipation of his arrest in connection with Crime No. 453/2019, registered with Nanded Rural Police Station, District Nanded, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26 (2) (iv), 27, 23, 30 (2) (a), 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act.

entities.text: Nanded Rural Police Station, District Nanded
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Shortly stated the prosecution case is to the effect that the police had trapped a co-accused and found that he was in possession of stock of scented Supari.
The stock was seized.
Samples were drawn.
Chemical analysis report was obtained and the FIR was lodged.
3. It is alleged that the co-accused has disclosed about having obtained 904ABA1589.19 these muddemal articles from the applicant and that is how now he is being sought to be implicated.
4. Learned advocate for the applicant submits that except Section 328 of the IPC, the other offences are bailable.
Section 328 of the IPC would not be applicable since there are no allegations about the substance having been administered to anybody.
The applicant was neither in possession of articles nor has he administered the substance to anybody.
He may be granted anticipatory bail.
5. Learned APP opposes the application.
He submits that the offence is serious and is affecting public health.

sentences.text: who had supplied it to him
. Custodial interrogation is necessary and the application may be rejected.
6. I have carefully gone through the papers.
The other offences being bailable, the only question to be decided would be as to how the ingredients of Section 328 of the IPC can be made out from the allegations.

Assuming that the articles seized are dangerous to human life, still the offence cannot be said to have been committed under Section 328 of IPC, which requires the 904ABA1589.19 intoxicant/spurious substance to have been administered to somebody.
Mere finding of a stock of such substance per say would not apply Section 328.

If such is the state of affairs, when the applicant was not found in possession of the substance and he has not administered it to somebody,
he deserves to be released on bail subject to the following conditions.
7. The application is allowed.

8. In the event of arrest of the applicant, he be released on bail on his executing a Personal Recognizance for an amount of Rs. 15,000/- and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to the condition that he shall attend the concerned police station and make himself available for interrogation as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.
9. The amount deposited by the applicant, pursuant to the order of this Court while granting ad interim bail be refunded to him.

( MANGESH S. PATIL, J. ) S.P.C.
